candidateDefinition: Recommendation-visible standalone or point-of-interest destination records surfaced by the frozen KAI-151 thematic candidate/exposure audit; hubs and already-sufficient records are retained for classification but are not mutated.
selectionMethod: Frozen five-duration recommendation exposure (shortOuting, halfDay, fullDay, 2d1n, 3d2n) across Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukuoka origins, filtered to the thematic signal and reviewed against destination-specific official operator, municipal, prefectural, or official tourism evidence.

records.name: Jigokudani Monkey Park

seasonMetadata.basis: No defensible four-season suitability vector was verified for this destination; unknown is preserved rather than inferred from scenery or climate.

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone wildlife destination whose official operator publishes a winter operating period and snow context.

observations: The operator notice says the winter season starts November 1 and lists winter business hours November 1 through March 31. The official home page says the valley is buried in snow almost one third of the year and is known for wild Japanese macaques.

records.decisionNote: The winter operating period is used as the preferred window; animal appearance remains condition-dependent.

records.name: Shiga Kogen

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone mountain destination with official ski-season dates.

officialEvidence.authority: Shiga Kogen Tourism Association official site
observations: The official site labels the seasons Green May-August, Autumn September-October, and Winter November-May; its winter page says skiing and snowboarding run from mid-November to May each year.

records.decisionNote: Month mapping follows the published November-May winter season; broader area coverage keeps non-winter values nonzero.

records.name: Nabana no Sato

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone park with an official winter illumination season.

officialEvidence.authority: Nabana no Sato / Nagashima Resort official operator
observations: The official operator presents the Nabana no Sato illumination as a seasonal attraction and the destination record documents the illumination season as October through May.

records.decisionNote: The long published illumination season is represented as a winter peak without claiming that other flower seasons disappear.

records.name: Kenrokuen Garden

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: Standalone garden with winter yukitsuri imagery but no checked official recurring peak window for the full destination.

observations: The official sources establish Kenrokuen identity, admission, and winter yukitsuri as a seasonal feature, but the checked material does not provide a recurring month window that justifies a full winter vector.

records.decisionNote: Retain unknown rather than turning an iconic feature into exact months.
